trigger: Hormuz shipping threats intensified after Indian holiday
magnitude: High negative: reports of closure / threats to transiting vessels; Asia sharply lower.
reason: Potential blockage of a major oil route raises India's energy costs, inflation and risk premia. Reports of closure treated as reported threats, not proof that all traffic stopped.
timing: 4 Mar 08:20 IST report; 3 Mar holiday allowed accumulated war news before reopening. 2 Mar flows are older background.

trigger: Global rebound as oil rally paused / dollar softened
magnitude: Moderate positive: GIFT approximately +156 points; 4 Mar US equities rebounded.
reason: Reduced immediate energy-risk pressure and stronger global risk appetite can support a relief rally. China 4.5%-5% growth target is mixed, not the main positive surprise.
timing: 5 Mar 08:18 / 08:22 IST sources describe 4 Mar rebound and tempered oil rally.

trigger: Renewed oil spike and weaker US equities
magnitude: High negative: 5 Mar WTI +8.5% to USD 81.01; Brent +4.9% to USD 85.41; FII -INR 3,752 crore.
reason: Oil-supply risk worsens India's inflation/external balance and can compress consumer/company margins; outflows reinforce risk-off positioning.
timing: Upstox article updated 6 Mar 2026 08:27 IST explicitly states 5 Mar US oil settlements; before cutoff.

trigger: Oil surged at weekly reopening amid war supply disruption
magnitude: Extreme negative: early Brent / WTI near USD 119; Brent briefly +27% per morning research.
reason: An abrupt oil shock threatens India's inflation, FX and corporate margins, supporting broad de-risking. Later-day price retreat must not be backfilled into morning evidence.
timing: Oil futures reopened 8 Mar US evening / early 9 Mar IST; First Tick 9 Mar 07:33 IST establishes weak preopen.

trigger: Trump suggested war nearing completion; oil retreated from spike
magnitude: High positive relief: GIFT +1.43% by 06:23; large oil reversal from USD 119 peak.
reason: De-escalation rhetoric and improved supply hopes reduce India's oil/FX risk premium and support rebound. Claim is not a confirmed ceasefire; full 10 Mar US oil settlement excluded.
timing: NDTV 10 Mar 06:23 IST; Reuters article first published 9 Mar 20:59 EDT = 10 Mar 06:29 IST, later updated. Use 9 Mar comments, not revised day's settlement.

trigger: Oil rebounded modestly; US equities lower amid widening conflict
magnitude: Moderate negative: Brent +0.91% to USD 88.60; GIFT about -60 points.
reason: Renewed energy uncertainty and weaker US equities can reverse relief positioning and pressure Indian valuations; Asian strength offsets. Later 11 Mar oil settlement not used.
timing: 11 Mar 07:16 IST report; quotes known before cutoff, actual later vessel attacks excluded unless previously reported.

trigger: Further shipping attacks / oil surge despite reserve-release plan
magnitude: High negative: Brent +6.9% to about USD 99.5; WTI +8.1% to USD 94.36 at 05:00 IST, despite emergency-reserve plan.
reason: Threats to physical supply can outweigh reserve relief, worsening India import and inflation outlook. Multiple war-related channels prevent precise attribution.
timing: Upstox updated 12 Mar 2026 08:44 IST; explicitly quotes WTI at 05:00 IST. All selected price evidence before cutoff.

trigger: Global stocks fell as Iran-war energy / inflation fears intensified
magnitude: High negative risk backdrop; US and early Asia lower.
reason: Persistent supply disruption raises inflation and borrowing-cost fears while lowering growth expectations, a negative combination for Indian equities.
timing: 13 Mar 06:57 / 07:33 IST reports; covers completed 12 Mar US session.

trigger: Positive Indian futures opposed renewed oil rise
magnitude: High mixed: Brent +2.88% to USD 106.11 at weekly reopening; GIFT firmer.
reason: Energy shock is adverse; rebound may reflect positioning / selective shipping hopes, but no verified pre-cutoff positive shock explains whole gain. Later Monday oil fall excluded.
timing: Oil quote 15 Mar 22:45 GMT = 16 Mar 04:15 IST; First Tick 07:30 IST. Opposing directions explicit.

trigger: Oil eased and US equities rebounded; domestic buying support
magnitude: Moderate positive: 16 Mar DII +INR 12,593 crore vs FII -INR 9,365 crore.
reason: Lower oil reduces India's cost / inflation risk and global rebound supports risk appetite; strong domestic demand can absorb foreign selling.
timing: 17 Mar 08:28 / 07:00 IST reports cover 16 Mar oil / equities and provisional flows.

trigger: Supportive overnight global equity cues ahead of Fed
magnitude: Moderate positive/mixed: US technology / Nasdaq gains; war risk persists.
reason: Global equity recovery can support Indian IT and risk appetite, though continuing oil uncertainty and upcoming Fed decision limit confidence. Actual Fed outcome not known yet.
timing: 18 Mar 07:01 IST report; Fed 18 Mar US afternoon announcement falls after Indian session and is excluded.

trigger: Energy-infrastructure attacks and Fed hold intensified stagflation fears
magnitude: High negative: South Pars strike / retaliatory Gulf energy attacks; Fed unchanged.
reason: Direct energy damage raises oil/LNG supply risk; persistent inflation limits monetary relief while hurting growth. Combined shock plausibly explains large risk-off move, not a precise causal share.
timing: Upstox 19 Mar 08:09 IST confirms escalation and Fed hold already known; 18 Mar US decision = 18 Mar 23:30 IST. Later oil peaks excluded.

trigger: Trump issued 48-hour Hormuz ultimatum / power-plant threat
magnitude: High negative escalation risk; deadline heightened threat to energy infrastructure.
reason: Potential wider infrastructure damage raises prolonged oil-supply and inflation risk, pressing Indian valuations. Later 23 Mar postponement occurred after cutoff and is excluded.
timing: Ultimatum Saturday US night = Sunday 22 Mar IST, eligible prior day; First Tick 23 Mar 07:24 IST. Later extension in retrospective excluded.

trigger: Trump signalled negotiation progress / paused Iran energy strikes
magnitude: High positive de-escalation relief: GIFT approximately +395 points.
reason: Lower near-term infrastructure / oil risk can lift global and Indian equities. Talks were claims, not a confirmed agreement; uncertainty remains.
timing: 24 Mar 07:02 / 08:19 IST reports cover 23 Mar comments and US rally after Indian close.

trigger: US-Iran peace-plan reports and oil below USD 100
magnitude: High/moderate positive relief: GIFT approximately +225 points; Asian stocks sharply higher.
reason: Lower oil and perceived diplomatic path improve India's inflation/import outlook and encourage risk-taking despite weaker prior US stocks and FII selling.
timing: Mint 25 Mar 07:03 IST already covers peace-plan report; later Iran response/rejection excluded.

trigger: Renewed war scepticism / global selloff after Indian holiday
magnitude: High negative global cue; Nasdaq weakness, stronger dollar; GIFT lower.
reason: Doubt about a durable settlement sustains oil/inflation risk and reduces equity appetite; any strike-delay announcement is an offset, not proof of resolved conflict.
timing: 27 Mar 07:14 / 07:36 IST reports; 26 Mar Indian market closed, overnight global losses eligible.

trigger: Kharg Island seizure comments / wider war fears hit Asia
magnitude: High negative escalation risk; Asian markets sharply lower; GIFT around 22,515.
reason: Threats to Iran's key oil-export terminal raise prolonged supply disruption / inflation risk and pressure Indian risk assets. Friday FII sales are older background.
timing: 30 Mar 08:13 / 07:31 IST reports establish pre-open escalation discussion and market response; later-session oil highs excluded.
